topScam.title: The FASTag Highway Blacklist Trap
topScam.scam: You get an urgent SMS saying your FASTag is blacklisted or KYC is expired, demanding a ₹45 pending fee within 2 hours or your vehicle will be stopped at the next toll plaza. The link opens a fake cloned website that captures your bank account and debit card details.
topScam.protection: Highway authorities never send SMS links to collect ₹45 or update KYC. Never click links in SMS. If you want to check your FASTag, open your own banking app or Paytm directly.

realityPick.title: The Proprietary Vendor Lock-In Squeeze
realityPick.myth: Building exclusively on a single proprietary LLM API is the fastest and safest path to market!
realityPick.reality: Single-vendor dependencies lead to sudden outages, unexpected price hikes, arbitrary rate-limit throttling, and forced deprecation cycles that break production prompts without warning.
realityPick.fix: Deploy an intelligent open-source API gateway with automatic multi-provider failover, unified routing, and drop-in open-weight model fallbacks.
realityPick.impact: A major proprietary API outage takes down customer support during Black Friday sales with zero fallback mechanism.
